snippet.title: Hazard Levels - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Hazard Levels 1.0 is OUT NOW on Steam, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S!

Grab up to three friends and dive into unstable rifts for physics-driven co-op horror, proximity-chat panic and complete chaos. Loot bizarre ingredients, survive unpredictable creatures, brew experimental perk cocktails and somehow make it back to the pub before last orders.

For a limited-time, save on the full game, the DLC, and the Digital Deluxe Edition! 

🎮 PLAY HAZARD LEVELS

Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1374680/Hazard_Levels/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=description&utm_campaign=launchtrailer

PlayStation 5:
https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/concept/10019290

Xbox Series X|S:
https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/hazard-levels/9PL81G0BWGDL

Free demo available on Steam, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

FEATURES ⤵️

• 1–4 player co-op with proximity voice chat and full crossplay  
• Procedurally generated rifts packed with changing layouts, hazards and threats  
• Grab, carry and throw physics-based loot with the Gravity Gauntlet  
• Survive unpredictable creatures as each expedition descends into chaos  
• Bring bizarre ingredients home and brew experimental perk cocktails  
• Return to The Fox Hole Arms, a British pub hiding a secret R&D facility  

💬 Join the Hazard Levels community:
https://discord.gg/asKp8Rg8mc

The deeper the rift, the stranger it gets. Just make it back before last orders.

#HazardLevels #CoopHorror #WalesInteractive
